questions.answer: Less social life compared to living on campus. But sometimes the room is bigger and better.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
If you want more time to travel and experience the country, then pick courses that are online and that have continuous assessment.
Try to live on campus as this can be way more social.
Rent a van.
